title: Almond Flour vs Wheat Flour: Which Has Fewer Carbs?

seo.title: Almond Flour vs Wheat Flour: Carbs
seo.meta_description: Almond flour often has about 20–25 g total carbs per 100 g versus 75–77 g in refined wheat flour, but it contains far more fat and calories and behaves differently in baking.
seo.search_intent: Compare almond and wheat flour by carbs, fiber, fat, protein, calories, and baking behavior.

excerpt: Almond flour typically provides about 20–25 g of total carbohydrate per 100 g compared with roughly 75–77 g in refined wheat flour. It also contains much more fat and fiber, so it is not a lower-calorie or 1:1 baking substitute.
content_html:
Almond flour and wheat flour are not close in carbohydrate density. Almond flour often contains about 20–25 g of total carbohydrate per 100 g, including roughly 10–12 g fiber, while refined wheat flour is around 75–77 g carbohydrate with only about 2–4 g fiber.

Almond flour replaces starch with fat

Almond flour can exceed 50 g fat per 100 g, compared with roughly 1–2 g in refined wheat flour. That is why lower carbohydrate does not mean lower calorie: almond flour commonly reaches 570–620 calories per 100 g versus about 350–370 for wheat flour.

It has more protein but no gluten network

Almond flour may provide around 20–25 g protein per 100 g versus roughly 9–13 g in wheat flour. Those almond proteins do not form gluten, so the extra protein cannot replace wheat's structural role in bread.

A 1:1 baking swap usually fails

Almond flour brings fat, absorbs liquid differently, and lacks gluten. Cakes can become dense or oily and yeast breads lose the elastic network needed to trap gas.

Serving size changes the scale, not the pattern

Thirty grams is a more realistic baking portion than 100 g, but the same trade-off remains: fewer carbs, more fat, and a different structure.

The useful conclusion

Almond flour is much lower in total carbohydrate and higher in fiber, but it is more calorie-dense and cannot simply replace wheat flour cup for cup.

faq.question: Which has fewer carbs?
faq.answer: Almond flour, roughly 20–25 g/100 g versus about 75–77 g/100 g in refined wheat flour.

faq.question: Does almond flour have fewer calories?
faq.answer: No. Its high fat content usually makes it more calorie-dense.

faq.question: Can it replace wheat flour 1:1?
faq.answer: Usually not. Almond flour lacks gluten and handles liquid very differently.
